name: GAN Iloilo Summer Open 2026

venue.name: Robinsons Pavia
venue.address: 2 Ungka I Barangay Rd, Pavia, Iloilo

information: Welcome to GAN Iloilo Summer Open 2026! This competition features the events 2x2, 3x3, 4x4, 5x5, 3x3 One-handed, Megaminx, clock, Pyraminx, and Skewb with 3x3 as the main event. We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing. This competition is hosted by young speedcubers in the Iloilo region, Inna Perez and Liam Tagomata and proudly sponsored by: ### **Learn How To Cube** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTcxNjMwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--682426fe151b6b68616efc54f75ec498a58babaf/image.png)
